A '''[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]''' was distinguished by their [[Mouth/Legends|beak-like mouths]], with sunken [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a three-pronged head crest, the largest portion extending from the top, while two others jutted from the sides of their heads.<ref name="AOTC" /> By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="EP2Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> [[Unidentified fin-headed Jedi Master/Legends|a member]] of this species had been a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], well known enough to have multiple busts of them displayed around the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]].<ref name="AOTC" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The species first appeared as a bust in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars:'' Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AOTC" /> This design was originally created as a maquette bust by [[John Knoll]] and team to serve as a potential design for the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], presented alongside twenty-three other species sculptures for [[George Lucas]] to choose from. Though Lucas would eventually request to combine two of the other head sculpts to better accommodate his vision,<ref name="FPtP">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=From Puppets to Pixels: Digital Characters in Episode II}}</ref> a handful of the unselected species maquettes would be recycled, with some like this one turned into busts to fill the Jedi Archives.<ref name="AOTC" />
